additional_info.subject: Possible Cooling System Malfunction – Charging Stations 312900727026 & 312900727002
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
I would like to report an unusual issue observed with two of our charging stations (IDs: 312900727026 and 312900727002). The cooling system appears to have been running continuously at full capacity for several weeks, despite the stations being in “power saving” mode and during nighttime hours when the outside temperature was below 16°C.
The cooling system only stopped after switching off breaker QA2. Once the breaker was turned back on, the system resumed normal operation.
I would appreciate it if you could investigate whether this is a known issue or if there is a relevant firmware update that could help prevent this from recurring.
Thank you in advance,
Ziv Vinitzer

additional_info.subject: Internal Note for NOC
additional_info.body:
Summary of the initial analysis.
Affected Chargers
:
312900727026
and

weeks
Cooling stopped
only after QA2 breaker reset

normal behavior
Logs Checked
:

In the event that the issue is confirmed to be related to the cooling unit, the EP1 should be replaced. Considering the charger’s manufacturing date is 03/02/2023, the replacement of EP1 will be covered accordingly.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419765-DC/Si-D/IL-[312900727026 & 312900727002] Cooling System Malfunction CRM:02679000128
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
Hope you are doing well.
As customer reported an issue with two of our charging stations (IDs: 312900727026 and 312900727002). The cooling system appears to have been running continuously at full capacity for several weeks, despite the stations being in “power saving” mode and during night time hours when the outside temperature was below 16°C.
As we analyzed the logs where it was showing the non-critical active error flags
DC2 Outlet not ready
,
PLC DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump error
), but now it is cleared.  And no critical error flags are active on both the chargers.
For details of the above error please refer the KA link for troubleshooting-
Emobility_SICD_HW_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan_or_Pump and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Knowledge - Microsoft Dynamics 365
Additionally, u
pon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 02/09/2025 as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
